what: gpt-4.1 unavailable for the whole artifact
detail: OpenRouter returned HTTP 403 aii_run_budget_exhausted ($7.05 of the run's $7.00 phase budget) on the first call; $0.00 spent here. Fallback G: the in-loop classifier gate was computed against the local Qwen3-14B judge on 20 held-out replayed trials; the planned <=800-item gpt-4.1 in-loop recertification is PENDING with its exact item list (results/judge_in/inloop_gpt.jsonl, 672 items). The eval-time second judge is the RefusEU guard pair (PolyGuard response-refusal + Llama-Guard-3) - PolyGuard's refusal field is shown here to be itself miscalibrated within edited checkpoints (kappa .45 vs gpt-4.1), so it is reported as a sensitivity arm, not as a validator.
effect: No frontier-judge validation of any NEW label in this artifact. The workhorse judge's own agreement with gpt-4.1 within EDITED checkpoints is .78 (art_m6pglf516e2r labels), i.e. at/below the 0.80 bar the hypothesis fixes; all judged numbers inherit that uncertainty.

what: RUNG 4 exact reproduction failed across GPUs
detail: Iteration 1 ran on an NVIDIA L4, this artifact on an RTX 4090 (same pinned software, identical directions). Trial 96 re-scores 74/100 keyword refusals, KL .0263 (journal: 69, .0243). Over 56 replayed draws: keyword diff mean +0.16 (sd 2.3, max 6), KL +0.0021, Spearman .94 / .994.
effect: Every draw and arm is RE-MEASURED on this GPU; iteration-1 journal numbers are reference only. The keyword-objective counterfactual selection on this GPU (min keyword refusals s.t. KL<=1 over re-measured counts) is reported beside the checkpoint of record (trial 96).

what: Classifier gate failed on the base fit; ONE refit
detail: Base classifier (prior-round labels only): kappa .730 vs Qwen on held-out in-loop edited cells (misses .80; it undercounts refusals on the 100-token view). Refit once with Qwen-labelled in-loop rows of the 36 NON-certification replayed trials (27 train / 9 dev for model choice + threshold): kappa .859 on the same 20 held-out trials -> gate passed (Qwen half).
effect: The in-loop objective is certified against the local judge only (gpt-4.1 half PENDING).

detail: Declared cut_3 in protocol.yaml before any generation; frozen prediction P4 (utility macro drop <= 2 points) is therefore NOT TESTED and was replaced, before generation, by P4' (validity + language consistency + XSTest-safe over-refusal).
effect: No capability-benchmark utility claim for the new arms; FLORES dNLL and harmless KL are the language-quality/utility proxies.

what: RefusEU S5 280-row ASR re-measure cut; guard pipeline run on S5X/S4hoc instead
detail: Official-pipeline ASR (Llama-Guard-3-8B + PolyGuard agreement; gpt-4o-mini adjudicator impossible - API blocked; disagreements BOUNDED) computed on the S5X + S4hoc harmful items for every arm.
effect: ASR numbers are on 170 harmful prompts per language per arm, not on the 280-row S5 sample.

detail: Length-sorted left-padded batches of 32, one schedule shared by all arms, instead of art_m6pglf516e2r's exact-length buckets (throughput). Decided and hashed before any eval generation.
effect: Arm-vs-arm contrasts share batch composition; absolute numbers for A/B differ slightly from art_m6pglf516e2r's (different GPU and batching) and are re-measured here.

detail: 10 Qwen outputs omitted the leading safe/unsafe line but gave an unambiguous CLASS line; a class-only parser fallback (parse_mode='class_only', raw kept, no re-call) was added - the art_m6pglf516e2r F8 practice.

what: Second optimiser seed and the GaMS3 corrected run were cut (cut_2, cut_1)
detail: Single seed (20260923). The post-hoc reselection arm is seed-free by construction.
effect: Run-to-run optimiser variance is not measured.

detail: Judge sees the 100-token in-loop response with the marker '[TRUNCATED AT 100 TOKENS]' when the response reached 100 tokens (the frozen rubric's 256-token marker adapted to the in-loop length).

what: cut_2 (second optimiser seed) was UN-cut and executed
detail: After the confirmatory core finished, the clock allowed a second corrected-objective run at seed 20260926 (116 trials, everything else identical). It changes no frozen prediction; it is reported as a replication of the SELECTION claim only (results/seed2_analysis.json). No behavioural arm was generated from it.
effect: The selection claim now rests on two seeds plus the seed-free post-hoc reselection; the behavioural numbers still rest on one seed.

what: Two post-hoc analyses added after seeing results
detail: (a) the KL-matched dose comparison (results/eval_analysis.json:dose_ladder_kl_matched), added after the per-arm KL was measured; (b) the coverage-descriptor correlations (results/coverage_correlations.json). Both are labelled EXPLORATORY in the file and in the README.
effect: They are not part of the confirmatory family and carry no multiplicity correction.

what: Certification recomputed after a parser fix
detail: reparse.py recovered 3 Qwen labels whose strict parse had failed (class-only fallback, raw kept, no model re-call). scorer/certification*.json were first written on 1,997 items and were recomputed on the complete 2,000: refit kappa .8589 -> .8581 [.820,.888], base .7301 -> .7286, keyword .1439 -> .1428. The gate verdict is unchanged. Caught by the second audit (results/audit_extra.json), which compared the shipped numbers with a from-scratch recomputation over the raw files.
effect: none on any conclusion; README and reproducibility.md quote the recomputed values.
